description: This file defines an Android Fragment class 'DeviceOwnerFragment' that demonstrates the usage of device management APIs for device owner applications. It includes UI logic for toggling global settings like auto time and time zone, and managing preferred launchers via the DevicePolicyManager.

classes.name: DeviceOwnerFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment demonstrating device management API usage for device owners, managing global settings and preferred launchers.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of DeviceOwnerFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and binds event listeners after the view has been created.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Obtains references to system services, specifically DevicePolicyManager.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates UI state and retrieval of current settings when fragment resumes.

methods.name: retrieveCurrentSettings
methods.description: Reads current global settings and available launchers, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: loadPersistentPreferredLauncher
methods.description: Loads stored preferred launcher package name from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: setPreferredLauncher
methods.description: Sets a selected launcher as the device's preferred launcher via DevicePolicyManager.

methods.description: Removes the current preferred launcher policy.
